title: Your developer job interviews
instruction: Explain your experience, meet a hiring manager and think aloud in a technical interview

vocabulary.example: The recruiter explained the next interview steps.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: A recrutadora explicou as próximas etapas da entrevista.

vocabulary.example: I read the job description before the interview.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Eu li a descrição da vaga antes da entrevista.

vocabulary.example: I have experience building web applications.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Tenho experiência em desenvolver aplicações web.

vocabulary.example: My strongest skills are React and problem solving.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Minhas principais habilidades são React e resolução de problemas.

vocabulary.example: The coding task is to improve a login form.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: O desafio de programação é melhorar um formulário de login.

vocabulary.example: Could you give me feedback on my approach?
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Você poderia me dar um retorno sobre minha abordagem?

homeworkVocabulary.example: The recruiter explained the next interview steps.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: A recrutadora explicou as próximas etapas da entrevista.

homeworkVocabulary.example: I read the job description before the interview.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Eu li a descrição da vaga antes da entrevista.

homeworkVocabulary.example: I have experience building web applications.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Tenho experiência em desenvolver aplicações web.

homeworkVocabulary.example: My strongest skills are React and problem solving.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Minhas principais habilidades são React e resolução de problemas.

homeworkVocabulary.example: The coding task is to improve a login form.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: O desafio de programação é melhorar um formulário de login.

homeworkVocabulary.example: Could you give me feedback on my approach?
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Você poderia me dar um retorno sobre minha abordagem?

homeworkVocabulary.example: I was responsible for the login form.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Eu fui responsável pelo formulário de login.

homeworkVocabulary.example: Let me give you a specific example.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Deixe-me dar um exemplo específico.

homeworkVocabulary.example: I’d start by checking the error response.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Eu começaria verificando a resposta de erro.

homeworkVocabulary.example: A clear error message is one requirement.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Uma mensagem de erro clara é um dos requisitos.

homeworkVocabulary.example: An incorrect password is one useful test case.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Uma senha incorreta é um caso de teste útil.

homeworkVocabulary.example: Let me check one assumption before I start.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Deixe-me confirmar uma suposição antes de começar.

homeworkVocabulary.example: Could you clarify the expected behavior?
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Você poderia esclarecer o comportamento esperado?

homeworkVocabulary.example: Let me walk you through my solution.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Deixe-me explicar minha solução passo a passo.

homeworkVocabulary.example: I reproduced the issue before I changed the code.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Eu reproduzi o problema antes de alterar o código.

homeworkVocabulary.example: This solution is simpler, but it needs another test.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Esta solução é mais simples, mas precisa de outro teste.

homeworkVocabulary.example: An empty email field is an edge case to check.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Um campo de email vazio é um caso limite a verificar.

homeworkVocabulary.example: Could we arrange a follow-up next week?
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Poderíamos marcar uma próxima conversa na semana que vem?

homeworkVocabulary.example: Thursday at ten works for me.
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Quinta-feira às dez funciona para mim.

homeworkVocabulary.example: How do you support new developers?
homeworkVocabulary.exampleTranslation: Como vocês apoiam novos desenvolvedores?

dialogue.speaker: Kim
dialogue.text: Tell me about a project you know well.
dialogue.displayText: Tell me about a project you know well

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.text: I built a customer portal. It helps customers sign in and check their orders.
dialogue.displayText: I built a customer portal. It helps customers sign in and check their orders

dialogue.speaker: Kim
dialogue.text: What was your own contribution to that project?
dialogue.displayText: What was your own contribution to that project?

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.text: I built the login form and its error messages. A teammate built the API.
dialogue.displayText: I built the login form and its error messages. A teammate built the API

dialogue.speaker: Kim
dialogue.text: What challenge did you face, and how did you handle it?
dialogue.displayText: What challenge did you face, and how did you handle it?

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.text: The page opened even when the password was wrong. I reproduced the issue, checked the error response and fixed the navigation. Then I tested correct and incorrect passwords.
dialogue.displayText: The page opened even when the password was wrong. I reproduced the issue, checked the error response and fixed the navigation. Then I tested correct and incorrect passwords

hiringCall.speaker: Kim
hiringCall.text: Thanks for joining. Could you introduce yourself and tell me what kind of development work interests you?
hiringCall.cue: Introduce yourself and connect your interests to the role
hiringCall.hint: I’m… / I work with… / I’m interested in…
hiringCall.example: I’m a frontend developer, and I’m interested in building useful, accessible web applications
hiringCall.displayText: Thanks for joining. Could you introduce yourself and tell me what kind of development work interests you?

hiringCall.speaker: Kim
hiringCall.text: Choose a real or practice project. What does it do, and who uses it?
hiringCall.cue: Explain the purpose and users of a project you know
hiringCall.hint: It helps… / People use it to…
hiringCall.example: My customer portal helps customers sign in and check their orders
hiringCall.displayText: Choose a real or practice project. What does it do, and who uses it?

hiringCall.speaker: Kim
hiringCall.text: What was your own contribution, and what did other people work on?
hiringCall.cue: Separate your contribution from the team’s work
hiringCall.hint: I was responsible for… / My teammate…
hiringCall.example: I built the login form and error messages, and a teammate built the API
hiringCall.displayText: What was your own contribution, and what did other people work on?

hiringCall.speaker: Kim
hiringCall.text: Describe a challenge you faced. What did you do, and what was the result?
hiringCall.cue: Give a specific problem, your action and the result
hiringCall.hint: The problem was… / I checked… / After that…
hiringCall.example: The page opened with an incorrect password, so I checked the response and fixed the navigation. After that, only successful logins opened the portal
hiringCall.displayText: Describe a challenge you faced. What did you do, and what was the result?

hiringCall.speaker: Kim
hiringCall.text: How do you handle feedback or a request that is not clear?
hiringCall.cue: Explain how you clarify and use feedback
hiringCall.hint: I ask… / I check… / Then I…
hiringCall.example: I ask for an example, confirm the requirement and test the change before asking for more feedback
hiringCall.displayText: How do you handle feedback or a request that is not clear?

hiringCall.speaker: Kim
hiringCall.text: What would you like to ask me about the role or the team?
hiringCall.cue: Ask a useful question about the job
hiringCall.example: How do you review code and support new developers during onboarding?
hiringCall.displayText: What would you like to ask me about the role or the team?

technicalCall.speaker: Priya
technicalCall.text: This login form opens the portal after an incorrect password. What would you clarify before changing the code?
technicalCall.cue: Ask about the expected success and error behavior
technicalCall.hint: What should happen if…? / Does the API…?
technicalCall.example: What should happen after an incorrect password, and how does the API report that error?
technicalCall.displayText: This login form opens the portal after an incorrect password. What would you clarify before changing the code?

technicalCall.speaker: Priya
technicalCall.text: The API returns a session for valid credentials and a four-oh-one error for invalid credentials. Explain how you would investigate the problem.
technicalCall.cue: Describe your first checks before proposing a fix
technicalCall.hint: First, I’d reproduce… / Then I’d inspect…
technicalCall.example: First, I’d reproduce the issue with a test account. Then I’d inspect the API response and check when the page navigates
technicalCall.displayText: The API returns a session for valid credentials and a four-oh-one error for invalid credentials. Explain how you would investigate the problem

technicalCall.speaker: Priya
technicalCall.text: What would you change, and why? You do not need to write code.
technicalCall.cue: Explain when the portal should open and when the form should stay visible
technicalCall.example: I’d only open the portal after a successful response with a session. Otherwise, I’d keep the form visible and show a clear error
technicalCall.displayText: What would you change, and why? You do not need to write code

technicalCall.speaker: Priya
technicalCall.text: How would you test the successful login, an incorrect password and an empty field?
technicalCall.cue: Explain the expected result for each test case
technicalCall.hint: With valid details… / With a wrong password… / If a field is empty…
technicalCall.example: With valid details, the portal opens. With an incorrect password, an error appears. With an empty field, the form asks for the missing information
technicalCall.displayText: How would you test the successful login, an incorrect password and an empty field?

technicalCall.speaker: Priya
technicalCall.text: What should happen if the network is unavailable? Explain one trade-off in your approach.
technicalCall.cue: Handle the network problem and explain a choice
technicalCall.hint: I’d show… / I’d let the user… / This is simpler, but…
technicalCall.example: I’d show a network message and let the user retry. A simple message is easier to build, but it should still explain the next step
technicalCall.displayText: What should happen if the network is unavailable? Explain one trade-off in your approach

technicalCall.speaker: Priya
technicalCall.text: Imagine I have not seen your code. Walk me through your solution and tell me what you would check next.
technicalCall.cue: Summarise the fix and one further check
technicalCall.hint: The form… / It only… / Next, I’d…
technicalCall.example: The form only opens the portal after a successful response. It explains errors without losing the email. Next, I’d check keyboard access and the mobile layout
technicalCall.displayText: Imagine I have not seen your code. Walk me through your solution and tell me what you would check next

whatsappMessage: Your interview is on Thursday at 10 a.m. Dublin time. Here are two notes to help you prepare.

notes.speaker: Priya
notes.text: For the technical interview, we’ll use a customer portal login. A customer enters an email and password. With a wrong password, the form should stay open and show a clear error. Please explain how you would investigate and test that behavior.

notes.speaker: Priya
notes.text: You don’t need to prepare slides or write code during the call. Bring one real or practice project and explain your own contribution. We’ll leave time for your questions about the team, and I’ll send feedback by Friday.
